title: Unit 2 第二课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词。

questions.prompt: 1. 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词。
questions.explanation: car, arm, garden中的画线字母组合ar均发长元音 /ɑː/；而warm中的ar发长元音 /ɔː/。故选 w<u>ar</u>m。

questions.prompt: 2. 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词。
questions.explanation: fun, duck中的字母u及money中的字母o均发短元音 /ʌ/；而July中的字母u发长元音 /uː/。故选 J<u>u</u>ly。

questions.prompt: 3. 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词。
questions.explanation: early中的ear、purse中的ur、girl中的ir在重读音节中均发长元音 /ɜː/；而away中的首字母a在非重读音节中发弱读短元音 /ə/。故选 <u>a</u>way。

questions.prompt: 4. 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线部分读音不一致的单词。
questions.explanation: rubber, sister中的er及colour中的our在非重读音节中均发弱读短元音 /ə/；而sir中的ir在重读音节中发长元音 /ɜː/。故选 s<u>ir</u>。

sections.title: 二、词形转换
sections.instruction: 根据要求写出下列单词的相应形式，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。

questions.translation: activity的复数形式是______。
questions.explanation: 可数名词activity以辅音字母加y结尾，变复数需变y为i加es，即activities。故选 activities。

questions.translation: different的名词形式是______。
questions.explanation: 形容词different的名词形式为difference，意为“差异，不同之处”。故选 difference。

questions.translation: piano的复数形式是______。
questions.explanation: 名词piano变复数属于以o结尾的外来词，直接加s，即pianos。故选 pianos。

questions.translation: they的形容词性物主代词是______。
questions.explanation: 人称代词主格they的形容词性物主代词为their，意为“他们的”。故选 their。

questions.translation: tall的反义词是______。
questions.explanation: 形容词tall意为“高的”，其表示身高的反义词为short（矮的）。故选 short。

questions.translation: brother的对应词是______。
questions.explanation: 名词brother意为“兄弟”，对应的女性亲属词为sister（姐妹）。故选 sister。

questions.translation: this的复数形式是______。
questions.explanation: 指示代词单数this（这个）的复数形式为these（这些）。故选 these。

sections.title: 三、根据句意或汉语提示写单词
sections.instruction: 根据汉语提示或句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. Going fishing is my father's favourite ______ (活动).
questions.translation: 去钓鱼是我爸爸最喜欢的活动。
questions.explanation: 名词activity意为“活动”，此处单数名词activity符合题意。故选 activity。

questions.prompt: 2. There is no ______ between the two pictures. They look the same.
questions.translation: 这两张图片之间没有区别。它们看起来一模一样。
questions.explanation: no后接名词，根据“They look the same”可知是没有差异，difference意为“差异，不同”。故选 difference。

questions.prompt: 3. I think a good friend makes me ______ (发笑).
questions.translation: 我认为一个好朋友能让我发笑。
questions.explanation: 动词make sb. do sth.后接动词原形，laugh意为“发笑，笑”。故选 laugh。

questions.translation: 多么好笑的故事啊！
questions.explanation: 感叹句中修饰名词story应用形容词funny（好笑的，滑稽的）。故选 funny。

questions.prompt:
5. —Can your sister play the piano or the ______ (小提琴)?
—She can play the piano.
questions.translation:
——你妹妹会弹钢琴还是拉小提琴？
——她会弹钢琴。
questions.explanation: 名词violin意为“小提琴”，play the violin意为“拉小提琴”。故选 violin。

sections.title: 四、选词填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下列句子，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处。

questions.translation:
——这些是谁的球拍？
——它们是我父母的。
questions.explanation: 根据these和They are可知第一空球拍应用复数bats；第二空表示父母两人的球拍，以s结尾的复数名词所有格直接加'，即parents'。故选 bats; parents'。

questions.translation: 琳达留着金色长发。
questions.explanation: 主语Linda为第三人称单数，表示“拥有/留着长发”用have的三单形式has。故选 has。

questions.translation: 他今天看起来非常高兴。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，感官系动词look需变为三单形式looks。故选 looks。

questions.prompt: 4. Those are ______ books. I enjoy reading very much.
questions.translation: 那些是我的书。我非常喜欢阅读。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词books应用形容词性物主代词my（我的）。故选 my。

questions.prompt:
5. —______ they have some tennis balls?
—Yes, they ______.
questions.translation:
——他们有一些网球吗？
——是的，他们有。
questions.explanation: 主语they为复数，一般疑问句助动词用Do；肯定简略回答为“Yes, they do.”。故选 Do; do。

sections.title: 五、用方框内的词填空
sections.instruction: 从方框中选择恰当的词或短语填空，每个选项只能用一次。

questions.translation: 我的朋友们非常热爱运动。
questions.explanation: 主语My friends为复数，love sports very much意为“非常热爱运动”，谓语用原形love。故选 love。

questions.prompt: 2. Don't ______ with others when someone answers the teacher's questions.
questions.translation: 有人回答老师问题时，不要和别人说话。
questions.explanation: 祈使句否定形式Don't后接动词原形，talk with sb.意为“与某人交谈/说话”。故选 talk。

questions.translation: 他的话让我感到快乐。
questions.explanation: 主语His words为复数，make sb. feel happy意为“让某人感到快乐”，动词用原形make。故选 make。

questions.prompt: 4. Dale and Jack ______ playing tennis together.
questions.translation: 戴尔和杰克一起打网球玩得很开心。
questions.explanation: have fun doing sth.为固定搭配，意为“做某事玩得很开心”，主语Dale and Jack为复数，用have fun。故选 have fun。

questions.prompt: 5. ______ your grandfather spend lots of time fishing?
questions.translation: 你爷爷花很多时间钓鱼吗？
questions.explanation: 主语your grandfather为第三人称单数，一般疑问句句首助动词用Does。句首首字母大写。故选 does。

sections.title: 六、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.prompt: brothers, you, do, have, any, or, sisters (?)
questions.answer: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
questions.translation: 你有兄弟或者姐妹吗？
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句：助动词“Do” + 主语“you” + 谓语“have” + 宾语“any brothers or sisters”，句末用问号。

questions.translation: 这是谁的二胡？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句：疑问短语“Whose erhu” + 系动词“is” + 主语“this”，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: your, have, hair, sister, long, does (?)
questions.answer: Does your sister have long hair?
questions.translation: 你妹妹留着长发吗？
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句：助动词“Does” + 主语“your sister” + 谓语“have” + 宾语“long hair”，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: play, do, basketball, after, friend, school, you, with, your (?)
questions.answer: Do you play basketball with your friend after school?
questions.translation: 放学后你和你的朋友一起打篮球吗？
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句：助动词“Do” + 主语“you” + 谓语“play” + 宾语“basketball” + 伴随状语“with your friend” + 时间状语“after school”，句末用问号。

questions.translation: 你祖母喜欢园艺吗？
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句：助动词“Does” + 主语“your grandmother” + 谓语“like” + 动名词宾语“gardening”，句末用问号。

sections.title: 七、句型转换
sections.instruction: 根据要求完成下列各句转换，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。

questions.prompt: 1. My grandfather plays the erhu very well. (改为一般疑问句)
options: Does your grandfather play the erhu very well?
Do your grandfather play the erhu very well?
Is your grandfather play the erhu very well?
Does your grandfather plays the erhu very well?
questions.translation:
——我祖父二胡拉得很好。（改为一般疑问句）
——你祖父二胡拉得很好吗？
questions.explanation: 原句谓语plays为第三人称单数形式，改为一般疑问句需在句首加助动词Does，主语My grandfather变为your grandfather，谓语动词恢复原形play。故选 Does your grandfather play the erhu very well?。

questions.prompt:
2. These are <u>my brother's</u> ping-pong bats. (对画线部分提问)
______ ping-pong bats are these?
questions.translation:
——这些是我弟弟的乒乓球拍。（对画线部分提问）
——这些是谁的乒乓球拍？
questions.explanation: 画线部分my brother's表示所有格归属，对其提问应用疑问代词Whose（谁的）。故选 Whose。

questions.prompt:
3. I often <u>play Chinese chess</u> with my brother. (对画线部分提问)
______ ______ you often ______ with your brother?
questions.translation:
——我经常和我哥哥下中国象棋。（对画线部分提问）
——你经常和你哥哥一起做什么？
questions.explanation: 画线部分为动作事件“play Chinese chess”，对动作提问用疑问代词What，主语you对应助动词do，后接实义动词原形do。故选 What do; do。

sections.title: 八、用正确的所有格形式填空
sections.instruction: 用括号内所给词的正确名词所有格形式填空，从每小题所给的选项中选出最佳答案。

questions.prompt: 1. This is ______ room. They get on well with each other. (Lucy and Lily)
questions.translation: 这是露西和莉莉共同的房间。她们彼此相处融洽。
questions.explanation: 根据单数名词room及后文“相处融洽”可知是两人共有的房间，两人共有时只需在最后一个名词后加's，即Lucy and Lily's。故选 Lucy and Lily's。

questions.prompt: 2. ______ marks (分数) in the exam are better than the other students'. (Lucy and Lily)
questions.translation: 露西和莉莉各自在考试中的分数都比其他学生好。
questions.explanation: 根据复数名词marks可知是露西和莉莉各自的分数，分别所有时需在每个人名后均加's，即Lucy's and Lily's。故选 Lucy's and Lily's。

questions.translation: 儿童节快到了。
questions.explanation: 不规则复数名词children变所有格直接加's，即Children's Day（儿童节）。句首首字母大写。故选 Children's。

questions.translation: 这些花是我姐姐们的。
questions.explanation: 以-s结尾的规则复数名词sisters变所有格直接加'，即sisters'。故选 sisters'。

questions.prompt:
5. —Where is ______ cousin? (Bob)
—He is in the classroom.
questions.translation:
——鲍勃的堂兄在哪里？
——他在教室里。
questions.explanation: 人名Bob变所有格加's，即Bob's cousin（鲍勃的堂兄）。故选 Bob's。

questions.translation:
——这是迈克的书吗？
——是的，它是。
questions.explanation: 人名Mike变所有格直接加's，即Mike's book（迈克的书）。故选 Mike's。

questions.prompt: 7. The room on the right is ______. (Helen)
questions.translation: 右边的房间是海伦的。
questions.explanation: 此处名词所有格Helen's独立作表语，相当于Helen's room。故选 Helen's。

questions.prompt:
8. —Who is the man in the car?
—He is ______ father. (Bob and Mary)
questions.translation:
——车里的那个男人是谁？
——他是鲍勃和玛丽共同的父亲。
questions.explanation: 单数名词father表明是两人共有的父亲，只需在后一个人名后加's，即Bob and Mary's father。故选 Bob and Mary's。

questions.translation: 今天是9月10日。它是教师节。
questions.explanation: “教师节”指全体教师的节日，用复数名词teachers的所有格形式Teachers' Day。句首首字母大写。故选 Teachers'。

questions.translation:
——这些是你的植物吗？
——不，它们是约翰的。
questions.explanation: 名词所有格John's独立作表语，指代John's plants。故选 John's。

questions.translation:
——你妈妈的生日是什么时候？
——在10月10日。
questions.explanation: 单数名词mother的所有格形式为mother's，意为“妈妈的”。故选 mother's。

questions.translation: 今天是中国的元旦/大年初一。
questions.explanation: 专有名词New Year's Day（新年/元旦）中名词year需用所有格Year's。故选 Year's。

sections.title: 九、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I am Bill Smith. I am an English teacher. My wife (妻子) is Linda Smith. She is a nurse. We have a daughter and a son.

These are my friends. This is Mr. Black. He's a worker. He works in a shoe factory (鞋厂). He makes shoes there. That's Mrs. Black. She's a farmer. She works on a farm (农场) near here. The girl is their daughter. She's a student. She's thirteen. The boy is their son. He is a young soldier (军人). His name is Carl Black. We are good friends.

questions.translation: 琳达是做什么工作的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“My wife is Linda Smith. She is a nurse.”可知，琳达是一名护士。故选 She's a nurse.。

options: He works in a shoe factory.
He works in a shoe shop.
questions.translation: 布莱克先生在哪里工作？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“This is Mr. Black... He works in a shoe factory.”可知，他在一家鞋厂工作。故选 He works in a shoe factory.。

questions.translation: 布莱克先生的女儿是做什么的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“The girl is their daughter. She's a student.”可知，她是学生。故选 She is a student.。

options: Carl is a friend of the Black family's.
questions.translation: 卡尔是谁？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“The boy is their son. He is a young soldier. His name is Carl Black.”可知，卡尔是布莱克先生的儿子。故选 Carl is Mr. Black's son.。

sections.title: 十、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处，使短文通顺完整。
sections.passage:
Many people often leave their hometowns to work in the cities. Zhang Bin, [1] 46-year-old man from Huaihua, is one such person. He [2] (work) in a factory in Wenzhou. He [3] (real) misses his hometown.

More and more hometowns [4] (be) developing faster than before. Large hospitals and new schools are built. There are many new roads and [5] (bridge). This has made traveling between villages and cities much easier. Thanks to the new roads around [6] (he) village, Zhang Bin will be able to [7] (open) an online shop that sells delicious food from his hometown.

Zhang Bin [8] (think) the changes are great in his hometown. He is very happy about the new school [9] his village. [10] he believes that one thing will never (绝不) change—the lovely old tree. The hometown is the place that holds his best memories.

questions.translation: 张斌，一名来自怀化的46岁男子，就是这样一个人。
questions.explanation: 46-year-old以辅音音素/f/开头，表示“一个”不定冠词用a。故选 a。

questions.translation: 他在温州的一家工厂工作。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，叙述常态用一般现在时，动词work变三单形式works。故选 works。

questions.translation: 他真的很想念他的家乡。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词misses应用副词really（真正地，确实）。故选 really。

questions.translation: 越来越多的家乡正发展得比以前更快。
questions.explanation: 主语More and more hometowns为复数，现在进行时be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 有许多新的道路和桥梁。
questions.explanation: many修饰可数名词复数，bridge变复数形式bridges。故选 bridges。

questions.translation: 多亏了他村子周围的新路……
questions.explanation: 修饰名词village应用形容词性物主代词his（他的）。故选 his。

questions.translation: ……张斌将能够开一家网店……
questions.explanation: be able to后接动词原形，即open an online shop。故选 open。

questions.translation: 张斌认为他家乡的变化很大。
questions.explanation: 主语Zhang Bin为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词think变三单形式thinks。故选 thinks。

questions.translation: 他对村里的新学校感到非常高兴。
questions.explanation: 表示“在村子里”，固定介词用in his village。故选 in。

questions.translation: 但他相信有一件事绝不会改变——那棵可爱的大老树。
questions.explanation: 前文描述家乡诸多巨大变化，后文强调有一件事绝不会变，前后句构成转折关系，用连词But。句首首字母大写。故选 But。

sections.title: 十一、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage: Let me introduce (介绍) my brother Jack to you. Jack is thirteen years old. He [1] Chinese and English very much. They are interesting. He [2] like math. It's too [3]. He doesn't like football, [4] he likes volleyball very much. Volleyball is fun. He [5] volleyball every day with his friends. He has a computer and [6] computer games. He plays computer games very [7]. He often [8] hamburgers, chicken and tomatoes. He doesn't like salad. He has a big room. And he has [9] great sports collection. Do you like him? [10] telephone number is 854-87416. If you want to make friends with him, call him.

questions.translation: 他非常喜欢中文和英语。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词用likes。故选 likes。

questions.translation: 他不喜欢数学。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，实义动词like的否定句借助助动词doesn't。故选 doesn't。

questions.translation: 它太难了。
questions.explanation: 因为不喜欢数学，理由是数学太难了（difficult）。故选 difficult。

questions.translation: 他不喜欢足球，但他非常喜欢排球。
questions.explanation: 前句否定“doesn't like football”，后句肯定“likes volleyball”，前后构成转折关系，用连词but。故选 but。

questions.translation: 他每天和他的朋友们打排球。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，打排球用play volleyball，动词用三单形式plays。故选 plays。

questions.translation: 他有一台电脑和许多电脑游戏。
questions.explanation: 修饰可数名词复数computer games应用lots of（许多）。故选 lots of。

questions.translation: 他电脑游戏玩得非常好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词短语plays computer games应用副词well（好地）。故选 well。

questions.translation: 他经常吃汉堡、鸡肉和西红柿。
questions.explanation: 主语He为第三人称单数，根据频度副词often可知用一般现在时，谓语动词用eats。故选 eats。

questions.translation: 而且他有很棒的体育收藏品。
questions.explanation: collection为可数名词单数，great以辅音音素开头，表示“一个”不定冠词用a。故选 a。

questions.translation: 他的电话号码是854-87416。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语telephone number应用形容词性物主代词His（他的）。句首首字母大写。故选 His。

sections.title: 十二、真题演练 (完形填空)
sections.instruction: 通读短文，掌握其大意，从每小题所给的三个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Do you expect [1] successful in everything you do? If so, then how? Here is an example. There was a farmer who grew corn all his life. Each year he [2] his corn to the market. Then each time his corn was chosen as the [3] and won the first prize.

One year a newspaper reporter interviewed him and learned [4] surprising about how he grew it. The farmer offered his seed (种子) corn to his neighbors. "How can you share your best seed corn with your neighbors?" the reporter asked, "You know they are taking part in the competition [5] you every year." "Didn't you know?" said the farmer, "The wind picks up pollen (花粉) from the corn and moves it [6] from field to field. If my neighbors grow bad corn, cross-pollination (异花传粉) will affect the quality of my corn. So if I want to grow good corn, I must help my neighbors to grow good corn."

The farmer knows much about the connection of life. His corn can't improve [7] his neighbors' corn improves.

As a great man says, "We [8] by what we grow; we make a life by what we give." We can't live without food, [9] and many other things. But a meaningful life is not decided by how much we can get, but by how much we can give others. Giving instead of [10] makes us different from other animals.

So if you choose to live well, you must help others to live well; if you choose to be happy, you must help others to find happiness in their life.

questions.translation: 你期望在你做的每件事上都获得成功吗？
questions.explanation: expect to do sth.为固定搭配，意为“期望做某事”，be successful应用不定式to be。故选 to be。

questions.translation: 每年他都把他的玉米带到市场上。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文语境“There was a farmer...”及“won the first prize”可知整篇故事叙述过去的事实，谓语动词用一般过去时took。故选 took。

questions.translation: 然后每一次他的玉米都被评选为最好的并且赢得了头奖。
questions.explanation: 根据定冠词the及“won the first prize”可知被评为最好的（the best）。故选 best。

questions.translation: 有一年一名报社记者采访了他，得知了一些关于他如何种植玉米的令人惊讶的事情。
questions.explanation: 肯定句中表示“一些令人惊讶的事”用复合不定代词something，形容词surprising置于其后作后置定语。故选 something。

questions.translation: “你知道他们每年都和你一起参与竞争。”
questions.explanation: competition with sb.意为“与某人竞争”，介词用with。故选 with。

questions.translation: 风从玉米中卷起花粉，并在田地之间快速移动它。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词moves应用副词quickly（迅速地）。故选 quickly。

questions.translation: 除非邻居的玉米改善，否则他的玉米无法改善。
questions.explanation: unless意为“除非……否则……”，引导条件状语从句，相当于if... not。故选 unless。

questions.translation: 正如有位伟人所说：“我们依靠种植之物谋生；我们依靠付出之物创造人生。”
questions.explanation: make a living为固定短语，意为“谋生”，主语We为第一人称复数，谓语用原形make a living。故选 make a living。

questions.translation: 没有食物、衣服和很多其他东西，我们无法生存。
questions.explanation: 表示穿在身上的衣服/服装用clothes（复数名词）；cloth指布料。故选 clothes。

questions.translation: 给予而非索取，使我们区别于其他动物。
questions.explanation: 介词短语instead of后接动名词形式getting，与前面的Giving构成并列对照。故选 getting。
